mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rose by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 showed sustained growth over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% annually, the real interest rate is negative, which historically has led to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the real interest rate is negative.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 250,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 250,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in a month.
